name: Silent Workflow — No Intermediate Messages
goal: Ensure bot does not display any intermediate or processing messages during workflow execution.
constraints: Employee details are valid. User selects 'hropsempletter'. Bot must not show any processing/acknowledgement messages before the final confirmation.

phases.description: Bot fetches and displays employee details.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays employee details and presents options.
Bot triggers mail workflow silently and only displays the final confirmation message if successful.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
